observation.command:
cd /tmp/kc-msg
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keycloak/keycloak/26.1.2/themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_de.properties" -o login_de.properties && echo "OK de $(wc -l < login_de.properties)"
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keycloak/keycloak/26.1.2/themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/login/messages/messages_en.properties" -o login_en.properties && echo "OK en $(wc -l < login_en.properties)"
echo "=== en keys ==="; grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" login_en.properties | head -12
echo "=== de keys ==="; grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" login_de.properties | head -12
